A deposit written to test what the layer preserves, retrieved by the layer, its survival list intact. The test result is the citation.

Card 4 gives the EXHAUST mechanism precisely, and it is the clearest statement of it in the corpus: "The work in which SPELLINGS EMERGES AS A CHARACTER AND DIES. Feist is born as the AUTHORIAL EXHAUST OF THAT DEATH — the name on the title page." Heteronymic Provenance Theory defines EXHAUST as the mechanism by which one heteronym dies and another emerges; here the layer composes the instance, correctly, with Ichabod Spellings’ death producing Jack Feist.
